title: reaper_events
description: Reaper-cycle and sanity-check event payloads. Keys are short-form (Object.Action); the runtime topic is `<source>.<category>.<short_form>` per the [Source].[Category].[Object].[Action] standard. Lateral emits these as `ctxt.lateral.<key>`. Object `reaper_cycle` is snake_case so Action stays a single word.
